title: Chunk
description: Indexed retrievable chunk. The Qdrant payload mirrors the same fields plus the embedding vector.

page.description: Legacy single-page citation string. New chunks emitted under the hierarchical chunking contract populate pageStart/pageEnd instead; page may still be derived (e.g., 'pp. 12-14') for display.

sectionPath.description: Ordered list of enclosing heading strings from document root. Empty for content preceding the first heading. Required for chunks produced under the hierarchical chunking contract (chunking-contract.md, ADR-0009).

pageStart.description: 1-indexed PDF page number of the first ParsedBlock in this chunk. Required for chunks produced under the hierarchical chunking contract.

pageEnd.description: 1-indexed PDF page number of the last ParsedBlock in this chunk. Must be >= pageStart when both are set.

parentChunkId.description: References chunks.chunkId of the parent when this chunk was produced by a sentence-boundary split inside a single oversized parent (chunking-contract.md §Chunk boundaries). NULL for top-level chunks. The join key for the Phase 2 graph traversal layer (ADR-0006).

embeddingModel.description: Versioned embedding model used at index time, e.g., 'openai:text-embedding-3-small@2024-03'.
